answer: Each identity escrows a fingerprint for its timber voyage over the ridge: route, timber load, cadence. An agent locks a 70-credit bond and runs a matching voyage each epoch, filing a key-signed log. Auditors match the log to the print: mismatch, late filing, or shared print burns the bond. First 39, kth 39+7(k-1), 1000th 7032; 1000 fakes pay 3,535,500, lock 70,000. Rented fingerprints fail: one crew, one ridge route. Honest agents pay 39 once.
